t: Look up at Keeling House, a sixteen-storey block of flats on Claredale Street in Bethnal Green. It was completed in 1957 as a cluster of four blocks of maisonettes arranged around a central service tower. It was designed by Denys Lasdun, hailed as the greatest English architect of the early heroic modern period. His best known work is the Royal National Theatre on the South Bank, a Grade II* listed example of Brutalist design. A radical renovation in 2001 added a penthouse storey and a concierge service.
